literal_meaning: ধনধারিণী পৃথিবী (bearer of wealth, referring to Earth)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বসুন্ধরা আমাদের সকলের জন্য অমূল্য সম্পদের উৎস।
example_sentences_in_english: Vasundhara is the source of all precious resources for us.
Protecting the Earth is our responsibility.
history: Derived from Sanskrit mythology where Earth is personified as a goddess, often invoked in Hindu texts like the Vedas.
note: These terms are more poetic synonyms than strict idioms, rooted in ancient Indian cosmology.
